DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの持ち物メモは、どの手続きの案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which procedure is this checklist for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月の住所の相談でもらいました。今日は別の証明書ですが、同じ物で足りると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別手続の持ち物メモを流用したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received it when asking about my address last month. Today I need a different certificate, but I thought the same items would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you reused a checklist for a different procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用件が違うと必要な物も変わります。今日は何を証明する書類が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Different requests can require different items. What do you need today's document to certify?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 収入についての書類です。前のメモに書いていない物は、不要だと考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の必要書類と誤った不要判断を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My income. I assumed anything not on the previous list was unnecessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the document you need today and your mistaken assumption about unnecessary items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の書類に合う案内を確認しましょう。提出先から名称や対象の年を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the instructions for today's document. Has the place you will submit it to specified the document name or relevant year?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙があります。ここに名称と去年の年が書いてあります。前のメモより、これを見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先指定の種類と年を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a paper. The name and last year are written here. I would like you to look at this rather than the old checklist.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the type and year specified by the submission destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。対象の年と種類を確認して必要な物をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will check the relevant year and type, then explain what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。前の案内が間違っていたのではなく、違う手続きに使ったことが問題ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧案内の誤りでなく適用違いと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The issue is not that the previous guidance was wrong, but that I used it for a different procedure, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the issue is different applicability rather than incorrect old guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。それぞれの用件で確認しましょう。今回の案内を別にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check each request separately. We will give you separate instructions for this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二つのメモに用件を書き分け、今回の条件で準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用件別にメモを分け準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will label the purpose of each of the two lists separately and prepare according to this request's conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate your notes by purpose and prepare accordingly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが今回の案内です。対象の年もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the instructions for this request. Please check the relevant year too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査着はこちらへお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please return the examination gown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返しました。これで帰ってよいですか。時計と財布は着替えた所に置いたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査着返却後も私物が残ると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have returned it. May I go home now? My watch and wallet are still where I changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that personal belongings remain after returning the examination gown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 私物を確認してからお帰りください。今その場所へ戻れるか担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check your belongings before leaving. I will ask the staff member whether you can return there now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査着を返した後は入れないと思い、取りに行くのを諦めかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却後に戻れないと思った不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could not go in after returning the gown and nearly gave up on collecting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your worry that you could not return after handing back the gown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却したことと、私物を残したことは別です。どこに置いたか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Returning the gown and leaving belongings behind are separate matters. Do you know where you left them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ロッカーではなく、着替える席の横の棚です。まだあるかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私物を置いた具体的位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the shelf beside the changing seat, not in a locker. I have not checked whether they are still there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the specific location where you left your belongings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を確認してご案内します。別の方が使っている場合、ご自身だけで入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the location and guide you. If someone else is using it, please do not go in on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。時計は黒いベルトで、財布は茶色です。担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 特徴を伝え係員の確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The watch has a black strap, and the wallet is brown. I will wait for the staff member to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the features and wait for the staff member's check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できたら一緒に回収します。ほかの持ち物も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After confirming, we will collect them together. Can you check your other belongings too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。携帯と上着は手元にあります。時計と財布を確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手元品と未回収品を照合して帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have my phone and jacket with me. I will confirm my watch and wallet before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check what you have and what is still uncollected before going home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えました。ここでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have informed the staff member. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前回の相談番号はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know your previous consultation number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯に六桁の番号が来ています。これを言えば私の相談が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の六桁を相談番号と思ったと質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a six-digit number on my phone. If I give you that, can you identify my consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the six digits on your phone are the consultation number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何の通知に付いた番号ですか。個人アカウントの認証番号なら伝えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What notification came with the number? If it is an authentication code for a personal account, please do not tell us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: SNSへのログイン通知です。相談した日に来たので、警察の番号だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知がSNSログイン用だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is an SNS login notification. It came on the day I consulted you, so I thought it was a police number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the notification is for an SNS login. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その番号は読み上げず、前回お渡しした案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not read that number aloud. Let us check the information sheet we gave you last time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙の案内があります。担当の名前と番号が書かれています。この紙の番号を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙の相談案内へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the paper information sheet. It has the staff member's name and a number. I will use the number on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to the paper consultation information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらの案内で確認します。SNSの通知は別の問題として気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will check using this sheet. Is there anything about the SNS notification you want to discuss as a separate issue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分でログインした時の通知なので、被害の相談を追加するつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 認証通知は別の被害申告でないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was a notification from when I logged in myself, so I do not intend to add a report of harm about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the authentication notification is not a separate report of harm. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。では前回の相談について、確認したい内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Then please tell us what you want to confirm about the previous consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ相談の担当へ連絡したいです。紙の番号で照合し、アカウントの番号は伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談番号のみで担当への照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to contact the staff member for the same consultation. Please use the paper number to match it; I will not give the account code.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to contact the staff member using only the consultation number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内を確認しました。担当への連絡方法をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked the information sheet. I will explain how to contact the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの手紙を本日差し出されますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to post this letter today, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一週間前に書いたので、本文の日付も一週間前です。今日出すなら全部書き直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本文の旧日付を理由に書直しが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote it a week ago, so the date in the text is also a week ago. If I send it today, do I have to rewrite everything?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the old date in the text means you need to rewrite it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本文の内容は差出人と受取人の間の物です。郵便の差出し日は、本文の日付と別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The letter's contents are between the sender and recipient. The mailing date is separate from the date in the text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ただ、「明日会います」と書いたままで、その約束はもう終わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過ぎた約束が未来表現のままと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. However, I still wrote 'I will see you tomorrow,' and that appointment has already passed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a past appointment is still written as a future event. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を確認してから送るか決めてください。受付前なので、一度持ち帰ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contents before deciding to send it. Since we have not accepted it yet, you can also take it home for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では持ち帰って書き直します。切手を貼っていますが、まだ差し出したことにはなっていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持帰りを選び未受付を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will take it home and rewrite it. It has a stamp attached, but it has not been posted yet, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to take it home and confirm it has not been accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、窓口では受け付けていません。封筒の表示と料金は再度お持ちの時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct; it has not been accepted at the counter. We will check the envelope details and postage when you bring it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しい本文にして、昔の約束の話は過去のこととして書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本文の出来事を過去表現へ直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will rewrite the text and describe the old appointment as something in the past.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will change the events in the letter to past-tense wording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容が整ってから封をしてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please seal it and bring it once the contents are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は出さず、本文の時制と宛名を見直してから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の差出しを保留し再持参すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not post it today. I will review the tenses in the text and the addressee before coming back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will postpone today's mailing and bring it again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 手紙をお返しします。今回の差出しは行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your letter back. Nothing has been posted this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about your balance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面にある金額を全部引き出して払う予定ですが、実際に使える金額と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示残高が全額利用可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to withdraw the entire amount on the screen to make a payment. Is it the same as the amount I can actually use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the displayed balance is entirely available. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の種類によります。確認中の取引などもありますので、画面と口座の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It depends on the type of display. There can also be transactions under review, so we will check the screen and account status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ処理中と書かれた入金があります。それも今使えると思って足しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 処理中入金を足して考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a deposit still marked as processing. I added that too, thinking I could use it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you included a deposit still being processed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未完了の入金は、使えると決めつけないでください。利用可能な金額を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not assume an incomplete deposit is available. The staff member will check the usable amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。相手に今日全額払うと言う前に、確定している分を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払約束前に確定額を知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before telling the other person I will pay the whole amount today, I want to know what is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to know the confirmed amount before promising payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した金額をご説明します。今後の入金が確定する時刻は、別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the amount we confirm. When future deposits will be finalized needs to be checked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。予定の入金を当てにして引出額を書かず、確認後に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確定入金を前提に引出額を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not write down a withdrawal amount relying on an expected deposit; I will decide after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not decide the withdrawal amount based on an unconfirmed deposit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。画面は確認できる状態でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will refer you to the staff member. Please have the screen available for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。残高と処理中の表示を見せ、使える分だけを確認してから支払いを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を示し利用可能分を確認して判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show the balance and processing display, confirm only what is available, and then discuss the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the display and decide after checking the available amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの商品がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a product you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この弁当を後で買いたいので、値引きされるまで別の棚へ隠しておこうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値引きまで商品を隠したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy this lunchbox later, so I thought I would hide it on another shelf until it is discounted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to hide a product until it is discounted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品を違う場所へ移して確保しないでください。今はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not move products elsewhere to keep them for yourself. Where is it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ手元です。隠していません。後で割引になると聞いたので待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動で値引きを待つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I still have it with me. I have not hidden it. I heard there may be a discount later, so I want to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not moved it and would like to wait for a discount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 値引きは保証されていません。冷蔵の商品は決められた売場へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: A discount is not guaranteed. Please return refrigerated products to their designated sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。持ったまま店内を長く歩くのも避けて、今戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長く携帯せず適切な棚へ戻すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will avoid carrying it around the shop for a long time and return it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will return it to the proper shelf without carrying it for a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お取り置きとして残すことはできません。後で商品がなくなる可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We cannot keep it as a reservation. It may be sold out later too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それでも大丈夫です。今は買わず、後で売場にある物から選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 欠品の可能性を受け入れ取置きを求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is fine. I will not buy it now and will choose from whatever is on the shelf later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the possibility of no stock and do not ask for a reservation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの元の棚へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please return it to its original shelf here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻しました。割引を約束されたとは思わず、隠して確保もしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 割引保証と隠れた確保をしないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have returned it. I will not think I was promised a discount or hide it to secure it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that there is no discount guarantee and you will not hide it to keep it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。必要な時にお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please choose what you need when you need it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの台から荷物を下ろしていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you take your belongings off this platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。平らなので机だと思いました。何か特別な物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 台を机と思ったと説明し意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. It was flat, so I thought it was a table. Is it something special?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the platform for a table and ask its meaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記念碑の一部です。休憩や荷物を置くための物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is part of a monument. It is not for resting or putting belongings on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。食べ物も出しかけたので、全部しまいます。汚していないか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食物も片付け汚れの確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was also starting to take out food, so I will put everything away. Please check whether I made it dirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put the food away too and ask for a check for dirt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。お客様は荷物を持って、休憩用の場所へ移ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it. Please take your belongings and move to a rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。写真に写した刻まれた文字の意味を、事務所で聞くこともできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 刻まれた文字の案内を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Can I also ask the office about the meaning of the engraved words I photographed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about information on the engraved words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内の有無は事務所で確認できます。文字をこすったり紙を貼ったりして調べないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The office can check whether information is available. Please do not investigate by rubbing the letters or attaching paper to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 触らず、撮った写真だけ持って行きます。まず荷物を休憩場所へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 碑に触らず写真だけで照会すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not touch it and will bring only the photo I took. First, I will move my belongings to the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask using only the photo without touching the monument. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。こちらには何も残さないようご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Check that you have left nothing here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。荷物を全部移し、碑の意味は写真で尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 物を残さず適切な場所へ移ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will move all my belongings and ask about the monument's meaning using the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave nothing and move to the appropriate place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。休憩場所はこちらの通路の先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. The rest area is farther along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どこまでご乗車ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この先の駅です。次の便は遅れた直通列車だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延便を直通と思った目的地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: To a station farther along. I thought the next service was a delayed through train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your destination and explain that you thought the delayed service was a through train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の便は、この教材では途中駅までの運転です。行先表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The next service in this learning material runs only as far as an intermediate station. Please check the destination display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時刻だけ見ていました。自分の駅まで行くか、表示の終点で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻と行先を分け終点確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was looking only at the time. I want to check the displayed terminus to see whether it reaches my station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the time from the destination and ask to check the terminus. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが次の便の終点です。先へ行く方法は当日の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the next service's terminus. We will check today's guidance for how to travel farther.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中駅へ着けば必ず乗継ぎがあるとは考えません。先の案内が分かってから乗るか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗継ぎ未確定を認め乗車判断を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume there is definitely a connection once I reach the intermediate station. I will decide whether to board after learning how to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the connection is unconfirmed and wait to decide whether to board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ場合と乗る場合の情報を係が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain the options for waiting and boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ相手には、直通で向かうとまだ伝えません。今は途中駅止まりを確認中と知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手へ直通到着を約束せず確認中を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not yet tell the person meeting me that I am coming directly. I will say that I am checking a service that terminates partway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not promise a direct arrival; tell the other person you are checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内が更新されることもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information may also be updated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。便の終点と先の移動方法を確認し、決めた行程を相手へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終点と先の方法を確認し行程を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the terminus and how to travel beyond it, then tell the other person the itinerary I decide on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the terminus and onward travel method and share the itinerary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では最新の行先と運行案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the latest destination and operating information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約されたご本人はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who is the person with the booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私です。家族三人の違う相談も、この枠で続けてできると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分予約で家族の別相談もできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Me. I thought we could also discuss the separate issues of my three family members one after another in this slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your booking can also cover your family's separate issues. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人の予約内容と、ほかの方の相談を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your own booked matter separately from other people's consultations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ世帯ならまとめられると思っていました。予約は私の転入相談だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約対象が自分の転入だけと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought members of the same household could combine them. The booking is only for my moving-in consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the booking covers only your own moving-in matter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族の方も来ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are your family members here too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は私だけです。本人に聞かず代理で全部決めず、相談方法を家族へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族不在と代理判断なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is only me today. I do not want to decide everything on their behalf without asking them; I would like to tell them how to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your family is absent and you will not make decisions on their behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの用件の受付方法を案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain how each type of request is accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用件は本人の希望を確認してから整理します。私の予約枠を勝手に家族名へ変更しないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族用件を確認し自分予約は維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will organize their requests after checking their wishes. Please do not change my booking slot to a family member's name without asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your family's requests while keeping your own booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、まずご本人の予約内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us first confirm the details of your own booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の相談を進め、家族には別の相談先と予約方法を確認して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人相談と家族への方法案内を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will proceed with my own consultation and check separate consultation services and booking methods to tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate your own consultation from information about methods for your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二つを分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will explain those two separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about a document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計の番号をもらったので、診断書もこの番号で受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計番号で診断書を受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a payment number. Can I also collect a medical certificate using this number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a payment number can be used to receive a medical certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計の案内と診断書の申込みは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check payment instructions separately from applying for a medical certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払った時に全部申込済みだと思っていました。診断書はまだ依頼していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診断書未依頼と会計との差を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought paying meant everything had been requested. I have not asked for a medical certificate yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you have not requested the medical certificate and distinguish it from payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な書類の種類と目的を担当に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the staff member what type of document you need and for what purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務先へ休みの説明に出したいです。会社の指定書式があるかはまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先提出目的と指定書式未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to submit it to my workplace to explain my absence. I do not yet know whether the company has a designated form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the workplace submission purpose and that a designated form is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定の有無も確認してください。発行条件と時期は担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check whether there is a designated form. The staff member will explain issuance conditions and timing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会計番号を書式へ転記して代用せず、会社に必要な書類を聞いてから依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号で代用せず勤務先条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not copy the payment number onto a form as a substitute. I will ask my company what document is needed before requesting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not use the number as a substitute; check workplace requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日、申込み方法を聞くことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can ask how to apply today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。方法と発行の確認先をメモし、会社の条件が分かってから申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方法と発行相談先を記録し条件後に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will note the method and whom to ask about issuance, then apply once I know my company's requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the method and issuance contact and request the document after checking the requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では書類担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the documents staff.
